Heavy Rain Triggers School Closures in Agra and Jharlavad Districts

On Saturday, the Uttar Pradesh weather department issued a red rain alert for Agra district. District Magistrate Manish Bansal ordered that all schools from nursery to class 12 in Agra be closed for the day. The same heavy‑rain warning led authorities in Jharlavad district to announce a holiday for all schools on 5 September. Both announcements were reported by state news outlets. No further action or reopening date was mentioned.
